# Support

## Bugs and incorrect Skill behavior

Open a GitHub Issue and use the Bug report form.

## Questions and usage help

Use GitHub Discussions so questions and answers can help other users too.

## New Skill ideas

Use the New Skill idea issue form. New Skills should solve a distinct, repeatable problem rather than duplicate an existing Skill.

## Security vulnerabilities

Do not post vulnerability details, credentials, private infrastructure, or sensitive logs in a public issue.

Use this repository's GitHub **Private vulnerability reporting** feature instead.

## Sensitive data

Before sharing logs, screenshots, command output, manifests, or configuration, remove credentials, tokens, private URLs, personal information, and private infrastructure details.
